name: modoc_trend_first_default_override
trend_window: last 30 days when current search results are available

korean.language_note: Use native Korean parent education phrasing from current search results. Keep the caregiver calm and well-rested unless the source script explicitly requires fatigue.

spanish.language_note: Use warm native Spanish phrasing from current search results. Avoid stereotype-led labels.

visual_policy: Use one video-level caregiver identity across all languages in the same run, but do not reuse the same pose, prop, room, or composition in every scene.
Use a clean, brand-safe caregiver design with bright eyes. Do not include an always-present prop in the character identity.
Each scene should use a distinct concrete action, ordinary prop, shot type, and background. Do not turn medical concepts into infographics or symbols.
Do not add dark circles, exhausted facial features, messy-night imagery, or 3am bedroom scenes unless the source script specifically requires a night scenario.
banned_templates: dark circles as a character trait
every Korean hook as 새벽 육아 or search anxiety
bgm_policy: BGM must be instrumental only, with no vocals, humming, lyrics, or artist names.
Use bright, clean, short-form instrumental music with a catchy first bar and room for voiceover.
For serious medical topics, stay parent-friendly and voiceover-safe without making the music somber or low-energy.
